notes.title: January Update - Now available!
notes.content:
Greetings drivers and happy new year!

We are pleased to announce that the January Update of WRC 10 is now available to download on your Steam client! This final major update of the game (as we shared in our Roadmap) is bringing the delayed [b]Teams Online[/b], a mode in which you can compete against other Teams on special challenges each week, the [b]Online Multiplayer Championship (also known as the esports WRC Championship[/b], and additional fixes to the game. For more details about the content this update, please go down a bit further in this article.

In the Teams Online mode, you will take part in weekly events against other teams. With good performances and consistency, your team can win events and climb a global leaderboard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/bbec65657a243f576b82ec97e0322a9ff7f451a4.png[/img]

Only a certain number of players (defined in the event), will have their points count toward the team's score. The best scores will count toward the total. if you're familiar with how the esports WRC Championship works (and how we count points for the Teams) this is extremely similar to what we've done in the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/fb61ac1eeca003e72dca2201823f6ac5a232bed0.png[/img]

We're also excited to announce that the esports WRC Championship 2022 is back and will start next Friday, January 14 with Rally Monte-Carlo. The Championship is opened to all players owning a copy of WRC 10. You can learn more about the competition on the official [url=http://www.esportswrc.com/]esports WRC website.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/e46ecc464908895d169455d8fb9506df2bbec5cf.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Modes[/h2]

[h3][b]New[/b]: Online Multiplayer Championship Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition of the esports WRC Championship Mode (starting January 14)
[/list]
[h3][b]New[/b]: Teams Online[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the Teams Online Mode, a player can only join or create a Team. To create a team you need to be at least Level 5.
[*] Each week, Teams are competing on a special challenge set up by the game
[*] Only a certain number of players from each Teams score points for the challenge, the number of players is set up in the challenge
[*] At the end of each week, points are distributed to the Teams according to the ranking of their legitimate leaderboard players
[*] Each seasons are 4 weeks long (and therefore are made of 4 challenges)
[/list]
[h3]Anniversary Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] The reference timing has been revised to make the events more accessible.[/list]
[h3]Spectator Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Custom liveries from other players are now visible in Spectator Mode[/list]
[h3]Livery Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Logos from certain esports Team of the 2021 esports WRC Championship have been added in the Livery Editor (esports section)[/list]
[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in all rallies as some cars were sometimes not aligned with the starting line
[*] Fixed the position of the Ford Fiesta 2017's exhaust flame
[*] Fixed a missing texture on the door of several cars[/list]
[h2]Controllers & Peripherals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed icons and prompts on the Thrustmaster T80
[*] The Haptic Feedback from the DualSense PS5 controller is now supported on PC*[/list][i]Note: The Adaptive Triggers are not supported[/i]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several Localization issues[/list]

notes.title: November Update - Now available!
notes.content:
Hello drivers!

We're pleased to announce that the November Update is now available to download on your Steam client, you can find its Patch Notes below this announcement for more details about what's new in WRC 10.

First of all, the [b]2021 Acropolis Rally[/b] is now available! With winding and dusty mountain roads, sometimes on cliff sides, the Greek Rally is known to be particularly challenging for drivers. Already present in the game since the launch through a historical event, the update brings 3 special stages in 2021 version to the experience and also joins the game's Career mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/2da46afbcbed17f2db138aaedee7b15bbd00fe98.png[/img]

As an anniversary edition of the Championship, we already offer a large number of historical and key events of the Championship since 1973. After the 3 Historical Events added in October, [b]5 new events[/b] are now available in WRC 10 including the [b]Richard Burns & Robert Reid[/b]'s victory in their [b]Subaru Impreza WRC[/b] during the [b]2000 Safari Rally Kenya[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/de8c6dcbb32f8ab8d87113a1ca01497da7924572.png[/img]

Finally, we also improve the Clubs by adding a new difficulty mode; [b]Realistic[/b]. This mode allows you to carry over the damage inflicted on the vehicle to the next stage, to place one or more service parks (and to impose a mandatory passage to a service park in order to equip the car with appropriate tires when the road surface changes between two stages), the stages are played in one shot and cannot be replayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/73777718f66802f3d2e751e2980859ef1e6d8512.png[/img]

notes.title: The October Update - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello drivers!

We're pleased to announce that the October Update is now available to download on your Steam client, you can find its Patch Notes below this announcement.

This free update adds the highly anticipated [b]Renties Ypres Rally Belgium[/b], added to the calendar in early 2021, you will have the opportunity to experience these new asphalt country roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/1c334350d6066b8e0688f2aca59c0b53b2e24a23.jpg[/img]

Narrow and winding, they are lined with ditches and posts and punctuated by numerous junctions. The road sides often bring dust and mud to the tarmac and make conditions slippery with drivers not hesitating to cut corners. In WRC 10, this rally consists of 6 stages plus a shakedown. 

Three new historic events make their appearance, featuring famous driver and co-driver duos in their original cars: the [b]1980 Rally Portugal[/b] with [b]Walter Röhrl[/b] and [b]Christian Geistdörfer[/b] in their [b]Fiat 131 Abarth[/b], the [b]1981 Rally Finland[/b] with [b]Ari Vatanen[/b] and [b]David Richards[/b] in their [b]Ford Escort MkII 1800[/b] and finally, the [b]2017 Rally Portugal[/b] with [b]Sébastien Ogier[/b] and [b]Julien Ingrassia[/b] in their [b]Ford Fiesta WRC[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307093/f4a78a21b662ccbf9363b1df53adf883419b6c70.png[/img]

And last, the [b]Co-Driver Mode[/b] is improved with the arrival of a [b]complete lexicon[/b] that makes the experience more accessible to you and promotes even more immersion!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]October Update Trailer[/h1]

[previewyoutube=8R0wbDonWXw;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]

[list]

[*] Finland 1981: Ari Vatanen / David Richards - Ford Escort MkII 1800
[*] Portugal 2017:  Sébastien Ogier / Julien Ingrassia - Ford Fiesta WRC[/list]
[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
3 new Historical cars have been added to the game:
[list]
[*] Fiat Abarth 131
[*] Ford Escort MkII 1800
[*] Ford Fiesta WRC 2017

[*] Fixed an issue on wipers when snowing/raining with the Citroen Xsara[/list]
[h2]Livery Editor[/h2]
[list]
[*] 250 new stickers have been added to the library
[*] Fixed issues linked to saving liveries in the Livery Editor[/list]
[h2]Co-Driver Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Co-Driver Mode has been improved with a new User Interface
[*] A Pacenote chart has been added to the game allowing co-drivers to give the proper calls to the driver through the voice-chat.[/list]
[h2]Career Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue as crew members were disappearing[/list]
[h2]Stages[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue related to the following stages: Rally Portugal - Lousada, Rally Estonia - Shakedown / Elva / Elva Reverse, Rally Estonia - Tartu, Rally Finland - Harju
[*] Crash fixed in Long Stages such as El Puma or El Puma Reverse[/list]
[h2]Peripherals[/h2]

[h2]Others[/h2]

[*] Fixed several Localization issues [/list]
Thank you everyone for your feedback and support following the release of WRC 10, it's been greatly helpful for the KT Racing development team to understand what to do in order to improve the game's quality.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.20.21
notes.content:
Hello Drivers,

A new update for WRC 10 (v.1.1.20.21) is now available to download on your Steam client. This hotfix addresses some of the issues you've reported us such as the easing the access for Private Teams in the Career Mode, balancing the difficulty of the Anniversary Mode events, resolving various compatibility issues with steering wheels and more!

Please read the patch notes below to learn about the hotfix's content.

[h2]Peripherals[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that would make players lost randomly the FFB of their Thrustmaster's steering wheels if they paused the game.
[*]Fixed FFB on Fanatec steering wheels
[*]Fix on all Fanatec steering wheels with shift light
[*]Fixed Localisation for some steering wheel names
[*]Empty cursor tooltip shown on the press start screen[/list]
[h2]Game balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Allowing Private Team access through WRC1 Category
[*]Fixed an issue with the Epic Stage of Rally Estonia (ES Kanepi) was interpreted as a SSS
[*]Fix issues when switching from a Manufacturer to a Private Team
[*]The difficulty of the Anniversary Events has been tweaked (required times have been increased from 10 to 30 seconds depending of the stages)[/list]
[h2]Performance issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix has been made on particles performances and spawn issues[/list]
[h2]Crash Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switching camera in replay on some shakedowns
[*]Changing Tyres in Manufacturer Tryout
[*]Voice chat issues[/list]
[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various polish & bug fixes
[*]Fix Clubs leaderboards display
[*]Fix the  End User License Agreement (EULA) which could open at the wrong moment[/list]
[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*]Update credits
[*]Fix on the Safe Area[/list]

Thanks to all of our players for being awesome, updates will keep coming. Let us know your feedback in the comments here or on the Steam forums!

notes.title: The Livery Editor makes its debut in WRC 10!
notes.content:
Hey drivers!

Never seen before in a WRC game, the [b]Livery Editor[/b] is a very comprehensive customisation tool which invites you to push the limits of your imagination. With WRC 10, it is now possible to create totally unique liveries from nearly thirty WRC, WRC 2, WRC 3 and Junior WRC cars included in the game, as well as the historical cars. Colours, shapes, stickers, logos, lettering… players can access to infinite possibilities to impose their style and wear their own designs, including in the Career Mode!

Check out our exclusive trailer highlighting the Livery Editor. Be sure to check our [b]F.A.Q[/b] to have more information about the mode.

[previewyoutube=lxkv17e6wGE;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]F.A.Q[/h1]

[b]How does the Livery Editor works?[/b]
[i]The Livery Editor will allow you to customise a car by selecting colours and adding stickers over it. You can access the Livery Editor through the game's main menu or by creating your own private team in the Career Mode of WRC 10.[/i]


[b]How many stickers can I add to a livery?[/b]
[i]You can add up to 500 stickers.[/i]


[b]Can I create my own stickers?[/b]
[i]Yes, you can create own stickers by modifying stickers already present in the Library and shape them to your creative will![/i]


[b]Are all colours and stickers available from the start?[/b]
[i]No, not all of them are available - to unlock you'll have to go through specific challenges and achievements (e.g: complete one season as a Junior WRC).[/i]


[b]How can I customise my car in the Career Mode?[/b]
[i]To customise your own car you'll first need to complete all Anniversary Events, after that - start a new WRC2/WRC3 Career and pick your own Private Team.[/i]


[b]Are all cars customisable in WRC 10?[/b]
[i]Nearly 30 cars from the game's entry list are customisable, however only the [b]Subaru Impreza WRC[/b] & the [b]Audi quattro[/b] aren't available in the Livery Editor.[/i]


[b]Are you planning to add more content to the Livery Editor?[/b]
[i]Yes! Following the launch of WRC 10 this September, we will have two majors free post-launch updates which in addition to adding  new cars and stages will add new stickers & logos to the library.[/i]


[b]Can I import my own stickers to the Livery Editor?[/b]
[i]No, you cannot import stickers.[/i]


[b]Can I share my liveries to other members of the Community?[/b]
[i]It's currently not possible to do so. However, you can definitively share screenshots by using the Photo Mode or videos of your liveries![/i]

[hr][/hr]
If you have more questions about WRC 10's Livery Editor you can send us your questions on Steam or on our Facebook, Twitter or Reddit!

notes.title: WRC 10 | Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello WRC Drivers!

We are pleased to let you know that our team has worked on a hotfix for WRC 10 most of the issues with Thrustmaster devices.

[h2]Firmware[/h2]

[list][*] Updated SDK Thrustmaster enumeration of devices to make them work properly with other devices[/list]

For remaining problems with thrustmaster devices, please first check that your firmware are properly updated.

We are also aware of problems with certain NVidia drivers, we recommend you to use the version 457.09 (available here: [url=https://www.nvidia.fr/download/driverResults.aspx/166457]https://www.nvidia.fr/download/driverResults.aspx/166457[/url]/)

Our team will keep looking and your feedback during the Steam Next Fest and work on improving your experience for WRC 10's launch on [b]September 2, 2021[/b].

notes.title: WRC 10 to feature at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello WRC champions!

The team is thrilled to annonce our participation to [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. From [b]16 to 22 June[/b], a free demo version of WRC 10, the official game of the FIA World Rally Championship, will be playable exclusively on Steam. 

But that's not all! Today we are anslo unvealing one of the many historic events: [b]Acropolis Rally in Greece[/b]!

[previewyoutube=HyK6r4TEU2k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Steam Next Fest – first look at WRC 10![/h2]

During Steam Next Fest, PC players will be able to play an [b]exclusive demo of WRC 10[/b]. The demo includes an overview of three completely new rallies that have been added to this season's calendar: [b]Estonia [/b](gravel), [b]Croatia [/b](asphalt) and [b]Spain [/b](asphalt). Log in to Steam tomorrow for a full overview of the game's even more realistic driving experience and physics, which were widely acclaimed in WRC 9.

[h2]The Acropolis – A historic challenge in WRC 10[/h2]

The all-new [b]Anniversary mode[/b] in WRC 10 offers rally fans the chance to relive certain famous WRC moments, from 1973 to present day. Behind the wheel of cars from their respective eras, step into the shoes of some of the sport's best drivers and become a rally legend by completing the many challenges available.

In the Renault Alpine A110, Lancia Delta HF 4WD or maybe the Lancia 037, tackle the Acropolis Rally, one of the historic events included in WRC 10. With winding and dusty mountain roads, sometimes on the edges of cliffs, the Acropolis Rally of Greece is famous for being particularly challenging for drivers. In 2021 it is celebrating its big return to the Championship after an eight-year absence.

[b]WRC 10 will be available on 2 September 2021 on Steam.[/b]
